candidate_workaround: Split large generated artifacts into quote-safe apply_patch surfaces and keep JavaScript template literals free of unescaped Markdown backticks.
failure_signature: The orchestration parser encountered an unexpected backtick before apply_patch.
recurrence_guard: Scan cross-language template bodies for the outer delimiter before executing any nested edit call.
rollback: Discard the parser-rejected orchestration cell; it ran no nested tool and changed no file.
scope_boundary: Tamar v647-v3 workflow evidence only; no scientific, authority, production, or independent-reproduction claim.
title: Keep orchestration template delimiters out of generated artifact bodies
trigger_preconditions: A JavaScript orchestration template contains generated Markdown or Python source.
